fullPassage: I glanced at the clock on the wall. 10:00. That meant the casting director would call very soon with the results of my first audition for a musical part in The Wizard of Oz. I felt shaky all over, chewing my thumbnail and jiggling my feet. Finally, the telephone rang. While I was coming round, Dad answered. I heard him say, "Ahh, thank you. I'll let her know..." As I got to the bottom of the stairs, he was just putting the phone down. "That was The Wizard of Oz. You're second senior munchkin," he announced. I got a little rush of excitement, knowing I was in — that whatever happened I could be involved in one of the productions.

questions.passage: I glanced at the clock on the wall. 10:00. That meant the casting director would call very soon with the results of my first audition for a musical part in The Wizard of Oz. I felt shaky all over, chewing my thumbnail and jiggling my feet. Finally, the telephone rang. While I was coming round, Dad answered. I heard him say, "Ahh, thank you. I'll let her know..." As I got to the bottom of the stairs, he was just putting the phone down. "That was The Wizard of Oz. You're second senior munchkin," he announced. I got a little rush of excitement, knowing <u>I was in</u> — that whatever happened I could be involved in one of the productions.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 I was in이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 배역에 합격/선발되었다는 뜻
det.analysis:
밑줄 친 'I was in'은 '나는 안에 있었다'는 문자 뜻이 아니라, 오디션에 '합격해서 배역에 들어갔다'는 뜻이에요. 바로 뒤 'I could be involved in one of the productions(공연에 참여할 수 있었다)'가 이 의미를 확인해줘요.
✅① I had been chosen for a role in the play (연극에서 배역을 맡게 되었다) ←정답! '합격/선발'의 의미와 맞아요.
❌② I had walked into the theater building (극장 건물 안으로 걸어 들어갔다): 물리적으로 들어간다는 문자 해석이라 틀려요.
❌③ I was on the list of the audience (관객 명단에 있었다): 배우가 된 것이지 관객이 아니에요.
❌④ I was inside the house at that time (그때 집 안에 있었다): 장소를 뜻하는 것이 아니에요.

det.analysis:
밑줄 친 'her'는 아빠가 전화 상대에게 한 말 'I'll let her know(제가 그 애에게 알려줄게요)' 속에 있어요. 아빠가 대신 알려줄 대상은 오디션을 본 딸, 즉 화자예요.
✅① 오디션을 본 화자 ←정답! 결과를 기다리는 사람이 바로 화자이고, 아빠가 그 결과를 전해줄 대상이에요.
❌② 전화를 건 캐스팅 담당자: 전화를 건 쪽이라 결과를 전해 받을 대상이 아니에요.
❌③ 화자의 어머니: 본문에 어머니는 등장하지 않아요.
❌④ 극단의 다른 단원: 문맥과 무관해요.

det.korean: would call very soon (곧 전화할 것이다)
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'That meant the casting director ___ with the results of my first audition(그것은 캐스팅 담당자가 첫 오디션 결과를 가지고 ___는 것을 뜻했다)'예요. 화자가 초조하게 기다리는 이유가 들어가요.
❌① had already left the office(이미 사무실을 떠났다): 결과를 기다리는 상황과 안 맞아요.
❌② refused to decide anything(아무것도 결정하기를 거부했다): 뒤에서 실제로 결과를 알려주므로 틀려요.
✅③ would call very soon ←정답! 시계를 보며 초조해하는 이유는 '곧 전화가 올 것'이기 때문이에요. would call(전화할 것이다)이 자연스러워요.
❌④ would never respond at all(전혀 응답하지 않을 것이다): 실제로 전화가 오므로 정반대예요.
det.tip: 곧 결과 전화가 온다 → would call very soon
